name: Tidecoal
place: scuttles along the black-sand coves north of Port Vharl at low tide; its shell smokes wherever a wave touches it
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A crawler whose shell is one lump of live coal. It spits hot coals that keep burning on the sand, and scuttles sideways down a line. At half health a wave breaks over it and the shell starts screaming steam: a scalding burst around it (back away) and cold spray flung up the beach.

party.solo: Fair solo at level 11: never stand on the coals.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The black rock on the tideline gets up. It is hot to look at.
A wave hits the boulder and it hisses. Then it turns round.
say.death: Tidecoal cracks open and goes dark. The tide washes over it with a long sigh of steam.
say.reset: Tidecoal settles back into the wet sand, smoking.

coal_spit.name: Coal Spit
coal_spit.say: {boss} spits glowing coals across the sand.

scuttle.name: Sideways Scuttle
scuttle.say: {boss} scuttles sideways at {target} — step off the line!

steam_burst.name: Steam Burst
steam_burst.say: The shell screams with steam — back away!

phases.name: Steaming Shell
phases.say: A wave breaks over Tidecoal. Its shell screams with steam!
